title: The handprint
logline: A child's plaster handprint the shop framed in 2005, in a hallway, and beside it on the wall a real hand — grown, resting there, the same hand. The page doesn't draw the person. Just the two hands.

panels.composition: A framed child's plaster handprint on a hallway wall and beside it, resting on the wall, an adult hand, the same hand grown, the rest of the person out of frame.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a framed child's plaster handprint on a hallway wall with an adult's hand resting on the wall beside it, the rest of the person out of frame, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
